title: Python TOFU eviction leaves unbounded stale SCHC peer contexts
description: When LinkLayer.receive admits a 65th pin, it removes only _pinned_keys[evicted_iid] and _key_generations[evicted_pubkey]. Any _schc_peer_contexts and _schc_peer_context_issuances for that signer remain. They become unusable but each later pin/DIO churn adds another entry, so authenticated peers can grow both registries without bound and leave session/reassembly policy state detached. Because eviction already chooses an unleased generation, retire the evicted signer atomically across DIO issuances/peer contexts/verified receipts/fragment sessions/reassembly and preserve permanent replay floor; add churn/capacity/persistence tests.
